column1: # Forge 1.5.2 -> 1.7.10 class renames (old<TAB>new), on top of forward/1.6.4/class-renames.tsv (a later file wins). Targets are checked against legacy/1.7.10/hierarchy.txt by Forward152Test.
# 1.5.2's EntityLiving is the base of every living entity (the player included, no EntityLivingBase): a type use of it means 1.7.10's EntityLivingBase. The cases
# that need the real EntityLiving (a class extending it, super calls) are kept apart by LivingSplit152 / LegacyRemapper (the Living152.KEEP marker); members only
# the string-path texture API: RenderEngine becomes the texture manager (bindTexture(String) is resolved by Textures152), TextureStitched a sprite
